https://co-lakewood.civicrec.com/CO/lakewood-co/catalog/index (Campsite Reservations: 'BCLP Campground Overview' / 'Bear Creek Lake Park Campground', Campsite 01-47, availability grid Oct 26 - Nov 1)

values.note: Campsites $40 a night, $34 for annual park pass holders; one vehicle pass is included, further vehicles need a park pass. Group site $120, yurt $55, cabin $65 ($10 pet fee in yurts and cabins).

fees.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('Camping fees $40 per night / $34 per night for annual park pass holders / $120 group area per night / $55 yurt; $65 cabin ($10 fee for pets)'; 'Fees: $40 per night ($6 discount for annual pass holders, includes one vehicle pass'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('Campsites feature a fire ring, a picnic table and electrical hookups. Sites 1-47 have been upgraded to 20/30/50 amp. The group loop has 20/30 amp.'), read 2026-10-26

sites.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('The campground features 47 campsites which can hold up to six people') + CivicRec 'Campsite Reservations' 47, read 2026-10-26

values.note: Shared water-fill station and spigots, restrooms with coin-operated showers, sanitation/dump station. In winter the water, showers and flush toilets are off (vault toilets; jugs can be filled at the visitor center).

facilities.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('Amenities include a shared water-fill station and spigots, on-site restrooms, coin operated showers, and a sanitation/dump station'; Off-season: 'Water is not available in the winter ... Showers and flush toilets are closed for the season. Vault toilets are available.'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('Regular camping season is April 1-October 31.'; 'Open April 1-October 31.'; winter camping is the group site only, for scout and youth groups), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Online through the City of Lakewood's CivicRec system (an account is needed; guests outside the US must give a US address), or call the visitor center, 303-697-6159. The 2026 season opened for booking on January 2, 2026. Full refund if cancelled 48 hours before check-in. After-hours entrance at 14218 W. Hampden Ave.

booking.source: https://www.lakewoodco.gov/.../Bear-Creek-Lake-Park/Camping ('Make a Reservation' -> co-lakewood.civicrec.com; 'Camping reservations for the 2026 season opened Friday, January 2, 2026'; Cancellation and Refunds; Pre-Arrival Information) + CivicRec catalog ('An account must be created in order to make a camping reservation'; sites bookable for Oct 27-31, 2026), read 2026-10-26

note: City of Lakewood campground in Bear Creek Lake Park, 15600 W Morrison Rd, ~15 mi from downtown Denver; also 3 cabins, 2 yurts and a group site. The campground sits north of and set back from Bear Creek Lake. --Claude
summary: City camping page + CivicRec: confirmed $40 ($34 pass holders), 47 sites with 20/30/50-amp electric, water spigots/fill station, showers, dump, Apr 1 - Oct 31, reservable online; added flush toilets, CivicRec url and booking note. Still taking nights through Oct 31. One campground. Note trimmed of the site/hookup/amenity/season/booking restatements.
flags: Rename: the city publishes ONE campground, named 'Bear Creek Lake Park Campground' (CivicRec facility 'Bear Creek Lake Park Campground', campsites 01-47; the camping page calls it 'the campground'). 'Indian Paintbrush' appears on neither the city page nor the booking system. Suggest renaming the entry to 'Bear Creek Lake Park Campground' (not to be confused with 252 Bear Creek Lake State Park, Virginia).
Site lengths and pull-throughs are not published on the city camping page; CivicRec's per-site detail pages were not read, so max_rig_ft is left unknown.
Website: the city camping page in `website` is current (403 to plain HTTP, loads in a browser). Booking engine: https://co-lakewood.civicrec.com/CO/lakewood-co/.
